full.description: This is a gross pathology image showing a cut section of an organ, likely a cyst or hollow viscus structure. The specimen reveals a thick fibrous wall containing numerous delicate, translucent membranous structures or daughter cysts floating within the lumen. The overall appearance is characteristic of a hydatid cyst caused by Echinococcus infection. The multi-layered laminated membrane and internal contents are clearly visible.

The panels provide different magnifications and details of the cyst's layered wall and contents.
